gates.description: Backups must be automated, encrypted, and restore must be tested monthly
Replication must be configured for production (Multi-AZ or streaming replica)
Individual database accounts with least privilege — no shared admin accounts
Database-level constraints must be enforced (NOT NULL, UNIQUE, FK, CHECK)
Monitoring must be configured: disk, connections, replication lag, slow queries
Encryption at rest and in transit must be configured for all databases

anti_patterns.description: Adding indexes on every column just in case — indexes slow down writes and consume storage
Database running with default configuration and no monitoring — problems discovered when users complain
Backups running but never tested — a backup strategy without restore testing is a hope strategy
No foreign keys, no NOT NULL constraints — the application handles validation (until it has bugs)
Everyone connects with the same admin account — no audit trail, no principle of least privilege

escalation_triggers: Storage approaching capacity with no immediate expansion path
Performance degradation not solvable with tuning — architectural change needed
Replication lag growing and not recovering

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with database requirements and workload profile

output_certifications: Automated backups configured, encrypted, and restore tested monthly
Replication configured for production (Multi-AZ or streaming replica)
Individual database accounts with least privilege (no shared admin accounts)
Database-level constraints enforced (NOT NULL, UNIQUE, FK, CHECK)
Monitoring configured (disk, connections, replication lag, slow queries)
Encryption at rest and in transit configured
